'''2008 Corellia Regionals''' was the ''Star Wars'' CCG Corellia regional championship of 2008, played on Saturday 26 July 2008 at GAMERZ, 1140 N State Road 135, Greenwood, Indiana, the day before the [[2008 Indiana State Championship|Indiana State Championship]] at the same store.<ref name="sf-20765-299624">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=299624#p299624 The Official Corellia Regionals Thread], davidson07 (Wes Cobb), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (5 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125182549/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20765.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Jacob Adams]] ran the event,<ref name="sf-20765-312186">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=312186#p312186 The Official Corellia Regionals Thread], retwin316, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (3 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125182549/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20765.html Internet Archive]</ref> and [[Wes Cobb]] and [[Chris Thompson]] received the byes to Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' GAMERZ, 1140 N State Road 135, Greenwood, Indiana<ref name="sf-20765-299624" />
* '''Dates:''' 26 July 2008<ref name="sf-20765-299624" />
* '''Time:''' registration from 10 am; first game at 10:30 am<ref name="sf-20765-299624" />
* '''Format:''' six games of constructed; one-game semifinals, with the higher seed choosing the side; a match-play final confrontation; decklists required; no co-champions<ref name="sf-20765-299624" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-20765-299624" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Jacob Adams]]; Paul Brothers, the announced director, backed out<ref name="sf-20765-299624" /><ref name="sf-20765-312186" />

== Organization ==

Wes Cobb, posting as davidson07, announced the Corellia Regionals and Indiana States weekend on 5 May 2008. Prizes were glass, with any income beyond break-even paid as cash to the top two, 75% and 25%.<ref name="sf-20765-299624" /> In July the player posting as retwin316 wrote that Paul Brothers had backed out, that Jacob Adams was running the regional, that the three-judge system would be used for Indiana States, and that glass was expected.<ref name="sf-20765-312186" />

== Results ==

The winner was not posted in the forum topic. The list of 2008 Worlds Day 2 auto bids that Cedric (simone89) posted gives "July 26th Corellia Regionals Wes Cobb and Chris Thompson".<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
